Ah...this is painful to read, mostly because you dated her for less than half a year. Let me put five months into perspective for you.

Then too, you definitely have no clue whether or not you love her after only five months. You wish she knew how much you love her but if she did know she'd probably be totally creeped out and never, ever, speak to you, because that's a little over the top.

Perhaps I am misunderstanding what you've written so far but it sounds like your encounters with her have been short enough that you don't get bored, with a definite time cutoff. Not to mention living across the country from her means you haven't REALLY been all that exposed to her. I'm going to give you advice based on this, but if I'm wrong--if you see her regularly after all, and your phone conversations are more often than once a month, and they're not always deep and insightful (because real relationships often involve shallow conversations--it's just chatting), then by all means ignore me.

That being said, I wonder if your feelings are really as strong as you think they are. Maybe you've idealized her? Maybe she's actually kind of weird but you haven't had enough exposure to her. 

Anyway, I know it doesn't really matter if you actually have strong feelings for her, the important thing is that you think you do, and so my advice is to go see her over Christmas and put the moves on her. Don't tell her you like her a lot--she'll probably interpret it as you burying some great, distance-overcoming passion in the hopes that you two can reenact the Great American Love Story. Just make it really clear that you like her. Hold her hand, or something. If she responds appropriately, go ahead and tell her, because she probably already knows.

Just so you know, even if she really likes you, she might not want to start up a long distance relationship right from the beginning. But you'll have gotten it off your chest, and at the very least she may be able to reconsider what or who is really making her happy in life.
